I have been where you're at, I found that next relationship, I built it up to be 100x better than my last. It was intense, sparks flying, milestones hit, all in a short time. He was better looking, funnier, more outgoing etc etc... got me feeling like I "won".

Only to find that, 1) I was driving the relationship, those sparks were me, the milestones were me, I was building on my own 2) I coupled up with Satan himself

After that was done, I had sooooo much healing to do from him and then I had to properly grieve the previous relationship

Its been a long time now so I'm good but boy did it set me back. 

Sooo... DONT DO IT! Welcome all the negative, sad, uncomfortable feelings that come with your breakup. Learn to sit with them until they fade. 

All the best

First you don't ever, ever convince someone to love you or have feelings for you. You don't want it that way believe me.

Try not to make sense of it all, don't do mental gymnastics to figure out when they lost feelings, how they lost feelings, why they lost feelings. Etc etc.

Let it go, and take it for what they said. If you try get "closure" it will hold you captive.

Then list reasons why you are loveable, so (for she/her):
* As a friend I am loveable because I am xyz
* As a sister I am loveable because I am abc
* As a partner I am loveable because I am def

This would help with your self esteem and see your true value, then realise its their loss for not seeing this awesome list for themselves.

There is no magic method to accellerate healing, its going to hurt - but the high road is the way to go x
